full_prompt_en: A square folk-art-like painting shows a close row of adults standing shoulder to shoulder along the bottom, beneath oversized patterned trees and fish-like shapes on a dark speckled ground. The people form a continuous horizontal procession from the left edge to the right, their feet touching a narrow black baseline. Most are shown in profile facing left; a few faces turn slightly or are partly hidden behind their neighbors. Long coats and dresses alternate in cream, muted red, olive, blue, tan, and dark brown. The garments have simple straight cuts, small patterned panels, and almost no modeled folds. A pale dress with red accents stands out just right of center, while a patterned cream-and-russet coat anchors the far left. Above the row, thick stylized trunks divide the upper space vertically. Their bark is filled with small geometric marks, and wide flattened canopies spread like horizontal shelves across the top. Between and behind them, a large pale blue-gray curved fish-like form points left, while a much larger rust-red fish shape faces right. Smaller cream fish or bird-like motifs float at the far sides. Scales, leaflets, and background grains are rendered as countless tiny repeated marks, giving the image a tapestry or mosaic texture. The figures remain much smaller than the upper motifs, so the scene follows a deliberate decorative scale rather than natural perspective. Illumination is flat and even: pale clothing and patterned shapes are legible against the dense blue-black ground, without visible cast shadows or a distinct light source. Edges stay clean but are softened by the dense stippling. No readable letters appear. The overall composition joins a tightly packed human frieze to fanciful large-scale upper forms, balancing restrained earth colors with intricate allover ornament.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形民间艺术般的绘画描绘一排成人肩并肩站在下方，头顶是巨大花纹树木和鱼形，背景是一片深色点状表面。人群从左边到右边组成连续水平队列，双脚碰到狭窄黑色基线。多数人以朝左的侧面呈现，少数脸略有转向或被邻人部分遮住。长外套与长裙在奶油色、低调红、橄榄色、蓝、褐和深棕之间交替。衣服剪裁简单笔直，带小的花纹面板，几乎没有明暗塑造的褶皱。中央偏右一件带红色强调的浅色裙子很突出，最左边则由一件奶油与赤褐花纹外套固定。人群上方，粗壮风格化树干竖向分割上部空间。树皮填有小几何笔迹，宽而扁平的树冠像水平架子般铺满顶部。树干之间与后方，一条巨大的浅蓝灰弯鱼形朝左，另一条更大的铁锈红鱼形朝右。更小的奶油色鱼形或鸟形纹样漂在两侧。鱼鳞、叶片与背景颗粒由无数重复的细小笔迹构成，让图像具有织毯或马赛克肌理。人物比上方纹样小得多，因此场景遵循有意安排的装饰性尺度，而非自然透视。照明平坦均匀：浅色衣物和花纹形体在浓密蓝黑背景前清楚可读，没有可见投影或特定光源。边缘保持清楚，却被密集点描柔化。没有可读字母。整体构图把紧密排列的人物饰带与幻想般的巨大上方形体结合，以克制土色平衡遍布全画的精细装饰。
style_prompt_en: The image has a folk-art and tapestry-like painted finish built from flat silhouettes and extremely dense repeated micro-marks. Earthy rust, cream, olive, faded blue, and charcoal interlock in patterned areas rather than smooth gradients. Upright small shapes form a tight lower frieze, while enlarged rounded and horizontal forms fill the upper field with deliberate decorative scale. Outlines are simple and clear, but stippled internal texture softens each colored plane. Even shadowless light keeps every patterned surface equally visible, so depth comes from overlap and size changes instead of optical modeling. Narrow gaps of near-black ground separate the crowded forms. The overall effect is whimsical, orderly, and intricately tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有民间艺术与织毯般的绘画完成面，由平面剪影和极密集重复的微小笔迹构成。土锈红、奶油色、橄榄色、褪色蓝与炭色交错成花纹区域，而非平滑渐层。直立的小形体组成紧密下部饰带，放大的圆润与水平形体以有意的装饰性尺度填满上方。轮廓简明清楚，点状内部肌理却柔化了每片色面。均匀无影的光让所有花纹表面同样可见，因此纵深来自交叠和尺度变化，而非光学塑形。拥挤形体之间只有狭窄近黑空隙。整体效果奇趣、有序而具有繁复触感。
theme_en: A line of people beneath patterned trees and oversized fish forms
theme_zh: 花纹树木与巨大鱼形下的一列人
name: Morris Hirshfield
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
